fields.Name: Skip ICF - Lapsed Membership Renewals
fields.Description: Ambiguous "lapsed member" definition: bought a membership product in 2025 but not in 2026, using Order Lines in the Memberships category. Tests that Skip states its definition (Subscriptions are empty in this world).

InputDefinition.userMessage: Which members bought a membership in 2025 but have not renewed in 2026? Show me how many there are by membership product and segment in a chart, and a table of the lapsed members with their last membership order date and amount. Explain how you defined 'lapsed'. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response explains its definition of lapsed (bought a membership product in 2025 with no membership order in 2026)
Uses confirmed Order Lines for products in the Memberships category (not empty subscription tables)
The lapsed count is large (about 1,240 people), consistent with most 2026 renewals not yet being in the data
Chart breaks lapsed members down by membership product (Individual is the largest) and/or segment
Table lists lapsed members with last membership order date and amount
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
